strengths: Username validation enforced via validateUsername + USERNAME_RE (3-32 chars, letters/numbers/underscore) before any DB work (oauth.ts:22-27); password strength enforced as >= 8 chars (oauth.ts:111)
Auth enforced: requireAuth middleware on both routes plus an explicit req.user null guard returning 401 (oauth.ts:16-17, 108-109)

Uniqueness handled at the DB level — UNIQUE(username) violation (PG code 23505) caught and mapped to 409 'Username already taken' (oauth.ts:96-100), correctly relying on the database for the concurrent-submission race rather than a check-then-insert TOCTOU

set-username strictly guarded to NULL-only (409 'Username already set' otherwise, oauth.ts:18-20); set-password strictly guarded to password_hash IS NULL (409 otherwise, oauth.ts:120-124) — no change-password logic, matching the must-not-have
Workspace provisioning wrapped in a proper transaction with BEGIN/COMMIT and ROLLBACK on error, client released in finally (oauth.ts:34-104)
Invite consumption correct: for each pending invite, INSERT workspace_members THEN DELETE the invite within the transaction (oauth.ts:83-91) — avoids the delete-only orphaning bug
createSignupWorkspacePlan reused from auth.ts (no duplication); USERNAME_RE and BCRYPT_ROUNDS imported as single source of truth
Router mounted on /api/auth (index.ts:93), outside the email-gate `api` Router, so completion routes bypass the email gate as specified
All 7 unit tests pass; server typecheck clean for oauth files; covers 200/400/409 paths for both routes including the 23505 unique-violation branch
